4. Leniency Bias: I did not rubber-stamp the Router. I independently verified the flower count by looking at the image and seeing multiple blooms per cluster, confirming the Router's observation was correct but the atom verdict should be 'false'.
5. Harshness Bias: I maintained the severity of the fusion artifact (severity 4) and text gibberish (severity 3). These are major structural failures, not minor texture anomalies. A score of 2.5 for authenticity is appropriate given that the main subject (motorcycle) is good, but the secondary subject (flowers) has severe physical impossibilities.

7. Upward Override Justification: I did not override any Router verdicts upwards. I agreed with all positive verdicts based on visual evidence (white color, stripes, presence). I confirmed the negative verdict for flower count based on visual inspection of the clusters.
